design.heading_rule: DD-057-4, confirmed at the freeze: an occurrence of 'positional analysis' (case-insensitive) anchors a passage only if it is in heading form - standing as the title of a section, chapter, appendix, or titled part, shown by standing alone as a line or running head, by chapter/appendix numbering, or by a table-of-contents entry pointing to the passage it introduces (spec section 5.1); running-text mentions, bibliography and reference entries, figure and table captions, and cross-references never anchor a passage, and the five passages do not borrow from each other
design.delimitation: spec section 5.2, with DD-057-11 (OPEN-2 resolved) confirming the S-3 case: the passage runs from the heading occurrence to the next heading of equal or higher rank, or to the document's end; running heads are one heading, not many passages; where the heading is the document's own title (S-3), the passage is the document's findings-bearing body, cited by line range in the passage artifact, not reprinted in the outcome record
design.stated_search: spec section 4, in order, per source: (1) the pinned held cleaned text at its section 2.1 path; (2) a repository-wide search for the document_id string, any candidate verified by SHA-256 against the cleaned-text pin; (3) the recorded stored paths in the source's registry file on the execution host, any candidate verified by SHA-256 against the registry's recorded checksum_sha256; (4) the source document itself, its text layer searched under the heading rule, a heading found there but not in the cleaned text extracted from the document with the discrepancy recorded. SOURCE UNLOCATED carries the sub-state DOCUMENT UNLOCATED or HEADING NOT PRESENT IN HELD TEXT (DD-057-10, OPEN-1 resolved, confirming DD-057-3), its full search log, and a named unblocking act on its row

accounting.recovered_standard: DD-057-14 (DD-057-5 confirmed): a located passage stating a checkable finding - a proposition about sign positions carrying a quantity, a named corpus, or a directional or comparative assertion checkable in principle - is CLAIM RECOVERED with its numbers verbatim as stated, or the recorded entry 'numbers: none stated' where it states none, its corpus and stated conditions as stated or 'not stated', and a falsifier written from the passage's own logic or the recorded absence of one
accounting.empty_standard: a located passage stating no checkable finding is PASSAGE EMPTY, with the passage quoted as evidence (the passage itself if short, or its opening and closing and the finding-bearing span the executor judged, with the judgement stated)
accounting.table: the outcome record's central table has exactly five rows, in spec section 2.1 order, each with citation, source claim_id, location state, locator or search-log reference, exactly one outcome, and the recovered claim id or evidence reference (spec section 6.1); a missing row, a row without an outcome, or a row its own evidence does not support is a failed execution under section 1.2

classes: B - COMPLETE ACCOUNTING, PARTIAL RECOVERY (r=1-4, u=0)
C - PARTIAL RECOVERY WITH UNLOCATED SOURCES (r=1-4, u>=1)
D - NO CLAIM RECOVERED: ALL PASSAGES EMPTY (r=0, u=0, e=5)
E - NO CLAIM RECOVERED: EMPTY AND UNLOCATED (r=0, u=1-4)
headline.rule: the headline is exactly one class, derived mechanically from the counts (r recovered, e empty, u unlocated; r+e+u=5), exhaustive over all 21 count combinations, under the pre-written wordings of spec section 7.1, with the counts shown beside the class; step-0 closures are stop classes, not headline classes

design.disposition: DD-057-15 (DD-057-7 confirmed): by appended, dated note on the canonical record only, the frozen record never edited - superseded by the named recovered claims if r>=1; retired as an extraction artefact if r=0 and u=0, with the five quoted passages as the note's evidence; no disposition if r=0 and u>=1 - the record stands as a stated gap, the note records the accounting so far and the named unblocking acts, and retirement is not available while a passage that might state a finding remains unlocated

recovered_claim.intake: DD-057-12 (OPEN-3 resolved), confirming DD-057-6: the intake records are produced inside this execution through the programme's intake; designing the recovered claims' checks is later work, per claim, outside this spec
recovered_claim.lifecycle: each recovered claim enters the claim set at the created stage, unchecked, with its proposition stated in plain words and the passage quoted beside it; recovery is not verification, and no output may present a recovered proposition as supported by its recovery

design.step0_gates: fail-closed, in order, before any passage is read for content (spec section 3): gate 0.1 input integrity - every section 2 pin hashes to its freeze-record value (a cleaned text absent is not a mismatch; it starts the stated search) - a mismatch closes as CLOSED AT STEP 0 - INPUT PIN MISMATCH, naming the input; gate 0.2 source-set integrity - the canonical record still carries exactly the four evidence instances of section 2.1 with the fingerprint a4874349... - a different set closes as CLOSED AT STEP 0 - SOURCE SET CHANGED; gate 0.3 order - the execution record shows the gate verdicts before the first per-source row, or the run is non-compliant on its face; nothing is repaired at run time
design.limits: spec section 9, binding on all outputs: recovery is not verification; no credit transfers from the programme's other positional records to this record or to a recovered claim; no invented propositions (a paraphrase that strengthens, narrows, or numbers a claim the passage did not make is a defect of the execution); the frozen records stand (products append beside them, never edit them); verbatim is internal - every registry record for the five sources carries license_status 'unclear', the passage artifacts are internal programme records, and any later publication use of passage text requires the registry's own license verification as its own act. Every execution product carries the fence sentence: 'This act recovered what five passages state. It checked none of it.'
design.freeze_does_not: this freeze does not itself extract, locate, or account for any passage: no passage has been read for content, no recovered claim has been stated, no source has been given an outcome, and the heading record stands exactly as recorded; extraction and accounting are execution outcomes under Phase-419, not freeze acts; the freeze also establishes nothing about sign positions
design.execution_gate: Not satisfied at the freeze of 2026-10-21: execution runs as Phase-419 only after this freeze has merged, the OSF contract registration's approval act has completed (the parent's approval click on OSF's admin notification), and a separate execution order is given, in campaign Wave 3 group 2
